The character must be a fictional original character, not a real person, celebrity, public figure, or photorealistic identity reference. Character name: Jaro Core character: A fictional young Korean male cyberpunk parkour scout with tousled black hair, cyan streak accents, athletic build, focused eyes, calm daring expression Role/archetype: combat-free parkour scout, agile rooftop runner, stealth delivery specialist, independent and observant Outfit and silhouette: black technical hooded jacket with cyan trim, layered utility vest, tapered cargo pants, fingerless gloves, reinforced high-grip sneakers Gear and important details: compact sling pack, wrist scanner, utility straps, reflective cyan tabs, close-up panels for gloves, shoes, straps, scanner, and pack Movement/action identity: parkour vaults, wall runs, rooftop sprints, precise landings, controlled acrobatic momentum, readable full-body poses Color palette: black, charcoal, cool gray, cyan, deep teal, small white reflective accents Visual style: stylized cinematic animation, fictional game character sheet, dynamic action reference, realistic fabric and gear, clean production layout One clean wide sheet/canvas containing many organized panels of the exact same character. shots.title: Push-off from ledge
shots.prompt: Use @Image1 as the primary character sheet reference. Single continuous shot with one main physical action. Start state: Character is crouched at the starting roof ledge, weight loaded forward, facing right, hands near knees, skyline behind.. Opening frame intent: Begin on the crouched preload at the ledge with the skyline glowing behind.. Main action: The runner drives forward into a clean acceleration step off the ledge and commits to the rooftop path.. Camera: Low side-tracking shot, moving parallel to the character with a slight push-in for speed and a readable silhouette.. Ending frame intent: End mid-acceleration with the body fully committed into the run.. End state: Character has left the ledge and is entering a fast run along the roof edge, torso low and balanced.. Sound design: Wind rush, fabric snap, a single foot plant on concrete, distant city hum.. Continuity handoff: Match the runner’s forward momentum into the next rooftop run.. Avoid cuts, new locations, outfit changes, identity drift, extra action beats, and unrelated sounds. Keep face, hair, outfit, palette, proportions, and gear consistent. Native audio must match only the visible action in this shot; do not carry over footsteps, impacts, engines, dialogue, music, or ambience from another shot unless explicitly visible here. Visual style: cinematic rooftop action, dynamic tracking camera, readable silhouette, practical fabric motion, dusk neon skyline, no impossible physics.
